topography.project_purpose: This brief describes the observed EVM deployment and audit surface for Kleros. It intentionally limits the description to receipted repository and on-chain evidence instead of inferring a business model.
topography.relationship_narrative: The pinned logic-topography run contains 43 contract row(s) across arbitrum, ethereum, gnosis, polygon, sepolia. Structural roles: 22 unclassified, 11 core, 10 supporting. 3 row(s) use upgradeable patterns.
